detail.longDescription:
Wingman is the AI agent that helps you run and grow your business. Not a chatbot that hands you advice, but an AI agent that does the actual work, the way a sharp new hire would. It focuses on what grows a business: reaching more customers, bringing in more leads, and helps you focus on your revenue.

Tell it what you need and it gets on with it. Wingman can run your marketing, write and design your content, do your research, manage your email and calendar, and take care of the admin tasks that piles up when you run everything yourself. It's built for founders, solopreneurs, and small teams who don't have the headcount but still have the work.

Some of the jobs people hand it:

Marketing and leads
Plan and run campaigns that reach more customers, write the posts and emails, and follow up so more leads become conversations.

Content and creative:
Draft the copy, make the images, and turn a rough idea into something you can ship.

Research:
Look into a market, a competitor, or a question, and come back with a real answer instead of ten links.

Email and calendar:
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar so Wingman drafts your replies and books your meetings.

Admin and follow-ups
Keep track of the loose ends and chase the things that usually slip through.

Connect the tools you already use
Wingman works with more than 300 integrations, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Outlook, Notion, Slack, Instagram, Facebook, Meta Ads, and Google Ads, so it acts where your business already runs.

Use it on any channel
Talk to Wingman on the app, or message it on WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage and web. Same Wingman, same memory, wherever you are.

An AI assistant that remembers you
Wingman keeps the context about you and your business, so every chat picks up where the last one left off. No starting over, no re-explaining yourself.

Hire more than one
Set up a Wingman for marketing, another for ops, another for whatever you need, each with its own focus. Add skills when you want it to do more, and drop them when you don't.

You stay in control
Wingman asks before it acts. You decide what it can access, and there are no surprise charges.

Getting started takes about a minute. Sign in, tell Wingman what you need, and start chatting.

Wingman is built by Emergent, the team behind the autonomous AI agent platform. The same technology now works for your business, on your phone.
